However, without any items to deliver, this fee likely hasn't been "added" in the sense of a running total of goods.

But typically, in these types of prompts, if no items are listed, the total is 0. The mention of the "flat delivery fee of 45" was a statement of fact/condition, not an addition to a cart.

Does the user ask to add the delivery fee? No, they just state it exists.
